ogren.title: Proposals
ogren.noneOpen: No pending proposals. New proposals appear when new corrections are read.

canvas.examples: Examples the proposal is based on
canvas.noneTitle: No before/after image for this proposal
canvas.previewAlt: The same example's final version, before and after the proposal

metrics.held: On the held-out test set, before and after
metrics.heldAdjust: On held-out jobs (each job once, centre computed from the other jobs), before and after
metrics.none: No before/after measurement on the held-out set.

note.draft: “Apply to draft” writes the rules only to the draft; production does not change until you publish.
note.template: Template changes are saved immediately (they do not wait for publishing); Undo returns the old value.
note.revertApplied: If you undo, the changed fields return to their previous values (changes you made by hand later are kept).
note.revertRejected: If you undo, the proposal goes back to pending.

toast.applied: Proposal applied to the draft. Check it with Try before publishing.
toast.appliedTemplate: Proposal applied; the template was updated.
toast.revertedOpen: Proposal undone; it is pending again.
